findings.title: Unvalidated manifest name used to build bundle and binary paths
findings.message: verify_suite builds paths from manifest['features'] entries without validating entry['name'], unlike catalog() which enforces r'[A-Za-z0-9 ]+'. A name such as '../..\u003crevil' (or one containing '/') escapes the bundle directory, so digest(binary) hashes an arbitrary attacker-chosen path. The BUILD.json digest check limits this to receipts the caller trusts, but this module's whole purpose is paranoid verification, so a malformed or tampered receipt turns into arbitrary file reads instead of a clean rejection.
findings.suggestion: Validate names before using them as path components: raise ValueError unless re.fullmatch(r'[A-Za-z0-9 ]+', entry['name']) before constructing bundle/binary paths.
